verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a hosted MCP server connecting AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Notion, PlanetScale Bot) to databases and Insights, letting agents run natural-language-driven queries, investigate performance, and even open PRs autonomously via 'skills' and self-improving database workflows. This is strong first-party evidence of natural-language/agentic operation, but missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically validating the MCP/agent natural-language workflow (community evidence covers Metal/migrations, not MCP agent use).
